bugs_found: apply_fee returns the fee amount, not the net amount, despite likely caller expectation of applying a fee
transfer does not coerce/validate amount as Decimal, so float/int/string inputs can cause TypeError after validation or inconsistent comparisons
transfer is non-atomic: debit happens before credit, so a failure on credit can leave balances inconsistent
compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and compounds_per_year via int(), changing financial results without error
loan_payment silently truncates fractional months via int(), changing financial results without error
fx_convert does not validate rate positivity/finite value, allowing zero/negative/NaN/Infinity rates to produce invalid conversions
money outputs are not quantized to currency precision, allowing sub-cent balances/fees/payments to propagate
